sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r1/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: 'Quality Checks'!A13:D13 (row 12, B - task.toml & run wiring) and 'Internal Quality Checks'!A13:D13 (internal wording identical in substance; no cell comments/threaded comments exist in the workbook package)
evidence: Frozen task/task.toml [environment] (lines 20-24) contains only build_timeout_sec=600.0, network_mode="public", cpus=2, memory_mb=4096; grep for 'docker_image' or 'image' over task/task.toml returns no match (rc=1), so no prebuilt image is configured anywhere (also none under [verifier.environment], lines 37-38). The block is byte-identical in keys/values to the template rules/projects/webdev-task-template/task.toml:20-24. The agent Dockerfile task/environment/Dockerfile has active build steps (FROM node:22-bookworm-slim; apt-get install line 5-7; npm install -g express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1 lines 9-12; COPY instructions/ and assets/ lines 14-15; git init /app lines 16-23), and these will actually be built because nothing shadows them. Requirement per workbook 'Quality Checks'!D13, quality-checks.md:53-54 and staged-task-contract.md:78 is satisfied. Counterexample probes: a broken variant that sets [environment].docker_image to a prebuilt node image would silently drop /assets/kittle.json, /instructions/*.md and the global express/better-sqlite3 modules - not present here. A conforming alternative (Dockerfile-only build, no docker_image) is exactly this task's configuration, so it cannot be wrongly failed. Static config check only; no Docker build was run for this row, but the row's requirement is a configuration property and does not require runtime measurement.
